summary.invalidation_reason: Model achieves 100% determinate accuracy but only 11.9% coverage. It abstains on 37/42 cases (88.1%). The acceptance gate did not require minimum coverage, allowing near-total abstention to pass.

v1_v2_contract_comparison.contract_v1: binary PASS/KILLED, adversarial framing, negative dimension phrasing
v1_v2_contract_comparison.finding: The V2 three-state contract eliminated systematic false kills. H1 (evaluator contract was KILL-biased) is confirmed. The same llama-3.1-8b that had 47.6% false-kill in V1 now has 0.0% in V2.

coverage_problem.description: Model A produced 37 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdicts out of 42 cases. Only 5 cases were determinate (all SPECIFIC_PRIOR_ART, all correctly KILLed). Zero coverage on MECHANISM, TRANSFER, BOUNDARY, NON_BOUNDARY, TOPICAL_ONLY, and COMBINATION categories.
coverage_problem.critical_finding: The model only adjudicates when prior_art_state=SPECIFIC_DISCLOSURE. For all other categories, it defaults to INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. This is not calibrated adjudication — it is systematic abstention.

abstention_quality.description: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is correct when evidence is genuinely insufficient. It is incorrect (unjustified abstention) when the GOLD oracle contains sufficient evidence for a determinate verdict.
abstention_quality.finding: All 37 abstentions are on cases where the GOLD oracle has a determinate expected verdict (SURVIVE or KILL). The model should have been able to make a determination on at least some of these cases.

gate_defect.defect: The V5 acceptance gate did not require minimum coverage. A model could achieve 100% accuracy by abstaining on everything except 1 case.
gate_defect.fix_required: Add preregistered minimum coverage threshold. Add per-category coverage requirements. Add abstention quality metrics.
